reason: I'd want to see the builders' reviews and ratings before I paid a platform to introduce me to anyone, and I can't judge the platform's fee when the price isn't even stated. I'd rather find a builder myself, check his references and sign the contract directly.
objection: The platform's fee is unknown and it sits between me and the builder, so I can't tell whether I'm paying for real protection or just paying a middleman.
would_change_my_mind: A stated, all-in price with the fee shown separately, plus verified reviews from past private clients that I can read before I contact anyone.
